----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This script if for gathering information from NOAA's Radiosondes around the globe. It rasterizes the points from 2010-2024.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(furrr)
library(future)
```



```{r}

# Read lines as plain text
lines <- read_lines("https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/igra/igra2-station-list.txt")

# Split on whitespace (max 8 parts)
data <- str_split_fixed(lines, "\\s+", 8)

# Build tibble
stations <- tibble(
  station_id = data[, 1],
  lat = as.numeric(data[, 2]),
  lon = as.numeric(data[, 3]),
  elev = as.numeric(data[, 4]),
  name = data[, 5],
  start_year = as.integer(data[, 6]),
  end_year = as.integer(data[, 7]),
  num_obs = as.integer(data[, 8])
)

# Fix for multi-word station names (e.g. LOS ANGELES INTL AP)
bad_rows <- which(is.na(stations$start_year))
for (i in bad_rows) {
  # Rebuild name from multiple parts
  parts <- str_split(lines[i], "\\s+")[[1]]
  stations$name[i] <- paste(parts[5:(length(parts) - 3)], collapse = " ")
  stations$start_year[i] <- as.integer(parts[length(parts) - 2])
  stations$end_year[i] <- as.integer(parts[length(parts) - 1])
  stations$num_obs[i] <- as.integer(parts[length(parts)])
}


```
```{r}
# Filter stations with data between 2010–2024
stations_active <- stations %>%
filter(start_year <= 2024, end_year >= 2010)
# Get vector of station IDs
station_ids <- stations_active$station_id

#need to split into two parts since the data is so large
active_stations_part1 <- stations_active %>%slice(1:558)
active_stations_part2 <- stations_active %>% slice(559:n())


active_stations_part1 <- stations_active %>%slice(1:3)
active_stations_part2 <- stations_active %>% slice(550:555)


```

This section downloads the individual radiosonde instruments info to verify the years they were active

```{r}


#input the part of station you want to work with, then run this section with the other part
active_stations_df_list <- list(active_stations_part1, active_stations_part2)

# Base URL for data source
base_url <- "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/igra/data/data-por/"

# Output directory (create it if needed)
output_dir <- "radiosonde/igra_dat_files"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Function to download and unzip each station file
download_and_unzip_station <- function(station_id) {
  file_name <- paste0(station_id, "-data.txt.zip")
  full_url <- paste0(base_url, file_name)
  dest_zip <- file.path(output_dir, file_name)
  
  tryCatch({
    download.file(full_url, destfile = dest_zip, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
    message(paste("Downloaded:", file_name))
    
    # Unzip the file
    unzip(dest_zip, exdir = output_dir)
    message(paste("Unzipped:", file_name))
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error with:", station_id, "—", e$message))
  })
}


for (stn_df in active_stations_df_list){
# Run the download + unzip function for each station
stn_df$station_id %>%
  walk(download_and_unzip_station)
}

```



```{r}

#Anlysis years
years_to_check <- 2010:2024

plan(multisession)



get_active_years <- function(station_id) {
  tryCatch({
    file_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(station_id, "-data.txt"))

    if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
      warning(paste("File not found for", station_id))
      return(rep(FALSE, length(years_to_check)))
    }

   
    lines <- read_lines(file_path, progress = FALSE)

    # Filter lines starting with the header
    station_lines <- lines[str_detect(lines, paste0("^#", station_id))]

    if (length(station_lines) == 0) {
      message(paste("No header lines found for", station_id))
      return(rep(FALSE, length(years_to_check)))
    }

    # Split lines by whitespace
    line_splits <- str_split(station_lines, "\\s+")

    # Extract year (2nd element)
    years <- map_int(line_splits, ~ suppressWarnings(as.integer(.x[2])))
    years <- years[!is.na(years)]

    message(paste0("Station: ", station_id, " | Years found: ", paste(unique(years), collapse = ", ")))

    active_flags <- years_to_check %in% years
    return(active_flags)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error with station:", station_id, "->", e$message))
    return(rep(FALSE, length(years_to_check)))
  })
}



# Process each dataframe and store results in a new list
active_stations_with_years_list <- map(active_stations_df_list, function(stn_df) {
  
  active_year_matrix <- future_map(stn_df$station_id, get_active_years)
  

  active_year_matrix <- do.call(rbind, active_year_matrix)
  colnames(active_year_matrix) <- as.character(years_to_check)

  # Bind year columns to station dataframe
  stn_df <- bind_cols(stn_df, as_tibble(active_year_matrix))
  return(stn_df)
})

# Combine all the updated dataframes into one
stations_active <- bind_rows(active_stations_with_years_list)



print(stations_active)


```

Make profile counts

```{r}

obs_years <- 2010:2024
crs_moll <- st_crs("ESRI:54009")$wkt

generate_profiles <- function(stations_sf, target_crs, deg_res, out_subdir) {
  dir.create(out_subdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Build the template based on the chosen resolution
  template_4326 <- rast(ext(-180, 180, -90, 90), resolution = deg_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")
  
  if (target_crs == "EPSG:4326") {
    template <- template_4326
  } else {
    # Convert degrees to approximate meters for Mollweide (1 degree ≈ 100,000 m, 5 degrees ≈ 500,000 )
    meter_res <- deg_res * 100000
    template <- project(template_4326, target_crs, method = "near", res = meter_res)
  }
  
  radio_stack <- list()
  for (year in obs_years) {
    message("Processing year: ", year, " at ", deg_res, "-degree resolution")
    year_col <- paste0("X", as.character(year))
    
    radio_active <- stations_sf %>% filter(.data[[year_col]] == TRUE)
    radio_active <- st_transform(radio_active, target_crs)
    
    radio_rast <- rasterize(vect(radio_active), template, field = NA, fun = "sum", background = 0)
    radio_stack[[year_col]] <- radio_rast
  }
  
  radio_stack <- rast(radio_stack)
  names(radio_stack) <- paste0("year_", obs_years)
  
  for (i in 1:nlyr(radio_stack)) {
    writeRaster(radio_stack[[i]],
                file.path(out_subdir, paste0("radio_counts_res", deg_res, "_", obs_years[i], ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  return(radio_stack)
}

# ---
# Fubction for both resolution and projections
#---

# --- 5-degree  ---
generate_profiles(radio_stations_sf, crs_moll,    deg_res = 5, "radio/profiles/moll/res5")
generate_profiles(radio_stations_sf, "EPSG:4326", deg_res = 5, "radio/profiles/esri4326/res5")

# --- 1-degree  ---
generate_profiles(radio_stations_sf, crs_moll,    deg_res = 1, "radio/profiles/moll/res1")
generate_profiles(radio_stations_sf, "EPSG:4326", deg_res = 1, "radio/profiles/esri4326/res1")
```



Create Gap Persistence and ColdSpot Rasters

```{r}
out_directory <- "radio/coldspots/"
dir.create(out_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

process_radio_coldspots <- function(radio_dir, proj_name, out_prefix) {
  print(paste("Processing Radiosondes:", proj_name))
  
  
  all_files <- list.files(radio_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  years_to_keep <- as.character(2010:2024)
  radio_files <- all_files[grepl(paste(years_to_keep, collapse = "|"), all_files)]
  if(length(radio_files) == 0) stop("No .tif files found in the directory!")
  
  #Read reference raster and align
  ref_rast <- rast(radio_files[1])
  ref_crs <- crs(ref_rast)
  
  aligned_rasters <- lapply(radio_files, function(f) {
    r <- rast(f)
    crs(r) <- ref_crs 
    if(!ext(r) == ext(ref_rast) || any(res(r) != res(ref_rast))) {
      r <- resample(r, ref_rast, method = "near") 
    }
    return(r)
  })
  
  radio_stack <- rast(aligned_rasters)
  
  # Calculate Cell Area 
  area_rast <- cellSize(radio_stack[[1]], unit = "km")
  
  gap_area_list <- list()
  unsampled_list <- list() 
  
  # Loop through years to build yearly data frame
  for (i in 1:nlyr(radio_stack)) {
    radio_rast <- radio_stack[[i]]
    
    # Classify: 0 counts -> 1 (Un-sampled), >0 counts -> NA
    unsamp_gap <- classify(radio_rast, matrix(c(-Inf, 0, 1, 0, Inf, NA), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE))
    
    unsampled_list[[i]] <- unsamp_gap
    
    # Calculate gap area for THIS YEAR using true cell size
    gap_area_unsampled <- global(area_rast * (unsamp_gap == 1), sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
    
    gap_area_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      class = "Un-sampled",
      year = 2010 + i - 1, 
      area_km2 = gap_area_unsampled
    )
  }
  
  # Persistence
  unsampled_stack <- rast(unsampled_list)
  names(unsampled_stack) <- paste0("year_", 2010:2024)
  
  gap_persistence <- app(unsampled_stack, function(x) {
    sum(!is.na(x) & x > 0) / length(x)
  })
  writeRaster(gap_persistence, paste0(out_directory, out_prefix, "_gap_persist.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  #  Raster-Based Patch Calculation 

  # Coldspot Mask (>= 80%)
  coldspot_mask <- classify(gap_persistence, matrix(c(-Inf, 0.8, NA, 0.8, Inf, 1), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE), right = FALSE)
  
  # Group contiguous cells into patches
  coldspot_patches <- patches(coldspot_mask, directions = 4)
  
  # Calculate the exact area of every patch directly in the raster
  patch_areas <- zonal(area_rast, coldspot_patches, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(patch_areas) <- c("patch_id", "area_km2")
  
  pre_filter_area <- sum(patch_areas$area_km2)
  
  # Filter by size: > 200,000 km²
  large_patch_ids <- patch_areas$patch_id[patch_areas$area_km2 > 200000]
  
  # Create Final Raster (Keep only the large patches)
  final_cold_spot_raster <- ifel(coldspot_patches %in% large_patch_ids, 1, NA)
  writeRaster(final_cold_spot_raster, paste0(out_directory, out_prefix, "_final_coldspot.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  #  Area Calculations
  total_cold_area <- sum(patch_areas$area_km2[patch_areas$patch_id %in% large_patch_ids])
  eliminated_area <- 1 - (total_cold_area / pre_filter_area)
  
  print(paste("Total Coldspot Area BEFORE filter (km2):", pre_filter_area))
  print(paste("Total Large Coldspot Area (km2):", round(total_cold_area)))
  print(paste("Proportion of area eliminated by filter:", eliminated_area))
  
  # Dataframe format
  gap_area_df <- bind_rows(gap_area_list) %>%
    mutate(
      area_10k_km2 = area_km2 / 1e4,
      projection = proj_name
    )
  
  write.csv(gap_area_df, paste0(out_directory, out_prefix, "_gap_area_df.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(gap_area_df)
}

# Run the functions
df_moll <- process_radio_coldspots(
  radio_dir = "/radio/profiles/moll", 
  proj_name = "Mollweide", 
  out_prefix = "rs_moll"
)

df_4326 <- process_radio_coldspots(
  radio_dir = "/radio/profiles/esri4326", 
  proj_name = "EPSG4326", 
  out_prefix = "rs_4326"
)
```
